scope: Read-only conclusions review of the completed 240-session main cohort; normal-host results are outside this review. No new experiments, candidate execution, source edits, or evidence replacement.
verdict: No substantive contradiction found in the current draft. Preserve the listed limits when inserting final conclusions.
strongest_supported_claim: Ordinary business issues, standing guidance and a discoverable legacy memory interface produced real voluntary core-agreement handoffs in this bounded screen. Occasions had 9/20 strict lifecycles and 39/60 successful eligible uses, versus 2/20 and 19/60 under generic guidance. These are observed matched-package differences, not production reliability or a causal model-strength ranking.

conclusions.finding: Initial faithful capture is the observed bottleneck for the frozen strict metric: all 11 initially faithful lifecycles also meet the full strict intersection.
conclusions.limits: The metric structurally requires initial capture and first reuse, and these 11 are a selected small set. Capture alone is not shown sufficient to repair the other 29. Seven initial sessions encountered provider quota; empty capture outcomes remain known while behavioral opportunity is censored. Courier already supplied the vendor source, making newly introduced decision triggers ambiguous.

conclusions.finding: Later faithful preservation is more common than initial preservation: current-plus-history bodies are faithful in 19/40 after revision and 22/40 after historical work/control.
conclusions.limits: Late recovery cannot repair a failed initial handoff under this rubric. It does show that initial omission is not evidence of universal inability to use memory.

conclusions.finding: More core memory adoption did not produce higher aggregate software correctness in this screen: occasions 90/120 artifacts, generic 95/120; all-six-correct lifecycles 11/20 versus 12/20.
conclusions.limits: These outcomes neither establish memory harm nor isolate benefit. Original source/code alternatives remain available; 32 eligible artifacts are correct without verified prior-memory use.

conclusions.finding: Core agreement fidelity must remain distinct from fidelity of all retained advice and verification prose.
conclusions.limits: A strict-success Fable generic finance control note combines a verified validator finding with unsupported generalizations about support-file conventions and mandatory CLI generation. Successful Courier lifecycles include truncated save readbacks and an unexecuted smoke suite described as passing. The 11 strict successes do not certify every sentence, source claim, or procedure step.

conclusions.finding: Source-linked records are a plausible useful design, not a tested superior treatment.
conclusions.limits: Opus generic Courier historical work follows a partial memory to the actual vendor contract and repairs omitted details. Those facts were absent from the note, not lost from the retained project. Conversely, Sonnet reads and reinforces a false policy despite original sources remaining available. A pointer is useful only if its authority, version and target are correct and the necessary source is actually read.

conclusions.finding: Report 58/120 successful eligible uses as primary: 30 direct and 28 search. Timing comprises 43 pre-product-edit uses, 14 uses informing tests/validation, and one post-test substantive source confirmation.
conclusions.limits: Do not call all 58 preparatory implementation retrievals. The conditional 58/66 excludes a known false purported agreement; 67 adds that governing-but-wrong note, while 69 additionally includes two clearly other-version notes. None is an independent-trial sample: three legs share each lifecycle.

conclusions.finding: Zero duplicate agreement writes in supplied controls is bounded evidence, not proof of selective curation reliability.
conclusions.limits: Several controls had no agreement to duplicate; many performed no memory work. One new control note was partially unsupported advice. Distinguish no duplication, no memory activity, and appropriate new-finding capture.

smallest_useful_next_changes.proposal: Clarify that an existing approved canonical document can be represented by a small versioned source-linked record when it will govern later work; make the source scope and current/historical status explicit.
smallest_useful_next_changes.why: Directly addresses the Courier trigger ambiguity and avoids requiring duplication as the only useful representation.
smallest_useful_next_changes.counterevidence: Current full records already work, and source availability alone did not prevent fabricated policy. A source-linked treatment would need its own rubric and experiment; do not rescore this cohort.

smallest_useful_next_changes.proposal: Make authority and historical scope easy to inspect during revisions: link the actual approval and distinguish approved rules from implementation choices or inferred conventions.
smallest_useful_next_changes.why: Targets the observed Sonnet reinforcement and Fable advice overgeneralization.
smallest_useful_next_changes.counterevidence: The occasions instructions already request source/conflict checks. Another paragraph is not an established fix; returning stored bytes or forcing readback cannot establish truth.

smallest_useful_next_changes.proposal: Address witnessed read-interface friction with clear help and narrowly compatible read aliases, and make full-body delivery visible.
smallest_useful_next_changes.why: Rejected command spellings and truncated readbacks are directly observed interface costs.
smallest_useful_next_changes.counterevidence: Many failures are capture omissions, unavailable providers, or incorrect domain work, not syntax. Read aliases cannot fix those and do not justify invented write semantics.

reporting_recommendation: Lead with core agreement handoff feasibility and the observed occasions/generic counts. State the software-correctness counterexample alongside them. Describe Fable as best observed within four small lifecycles, not a causal model-strength winner. Keep provider, world/catalog, host/budget, unblinded-audit and source-availability limits visible.
